mostWorthwhile.text: Aerobic ATP renewal was most worthwhile: the planned picture distinguishes fuel oxidation from oxygen’s role and connects the proton flow through ATP synthase to ATP production. The electron-transfer and H+ arrows are compact descriptions that could use more explanation for this audience.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed direct pairing of glycolytic cytosol with oxygen added little beyond identifying the required cell-interior hotspot; it was not obvious beforehand why the hotspot was necessary.

surprise.text: Protein construction automatically included glycolytic cytosol, connecting the synthesis result to cellular energy use even though I had selected only amino acids and the cell interior.

arbitrary.text: Using the cell interior rather than pairing glycolytic cytosol directly with oxygen felt somewhat arbitrary as an interaction, although the resulting mitochondrial setting had a clear biological purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the carrier, ATP renewal and pump constructions made useful structural and functional connections, and I would be curious to see how later chapters build on them.
